name: cookie-notice-wp
_comment: WordPress plugin 'Cookie Notice' (Hu-manity/dFactory), common on small Czech sites (dockhouse.cz). Only when the site enabled its refuse button; an accept-only notice is left alone. #cn-close-notice sets 'accept', never click it. Not autoconsent's 'WP Cookie Notice for GDPR' (#gdpr-cookie-consent-bar), a different plugin.
